comment.body: Thanks for confirming that no software was installed during the affected period. Because the report was captured on 0.100.2 and the ZIP was generated after PowerToys was reopened, could you confirm whether the Runner/tray icon still disappears after updating to PowerToys 0.101.x? If it does, immediately after it disappears and **before reopening PowerToys**, reply with `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP. That timing is needed to preserve any evidence of why the Runner exited.
